fields.area: Karun North, Bel Ravi and Soma Valley districts
fields.coverage: 212 households interviewed in 19 villages; 31 key informants; 64 health facilities visited.

needs.finding: 17 of 64 health facilities damaged; surgical capacity below need
Piped supply cut in two district towns; people rely on wells and trucking
About 38,000 households in damaged or unsafe homes; nights are cold
Markets are open but prices of flour have risen by a third

fields.method: Household and key informant interviews with a standard form on tablets. Villages were chosen to cover each district and the main road corridors.
fields.limitations: Hadar could not be reached. Figures are not representative of the whole province and will be revised.
